qualification.education_qualification: Graduate/Commerce Graduate with relevant experience as per post requirement.
qualification.details: Secretary: Graduate degree from a recognized University. Officers holding analogous Posts on regular basis OR With 2 years regular service in the pay matrix Level - 13'A' OR With 3 years regular service in the pay matrix Level 13 OR With 20 years of regular services in Central / State/UT Civil service out of which minimum 10 years in the pay matrix Level 12. Joint Secretary: Graduate degree from a recognized University. Officer holding analogous Post on regular basis OR With 3 years' regular service in the pay matrix Level - 10 OR With 5 years' regular service in the pay matrix Level - 8 OR With 8 years' regular service in the Pay matrix Level - 6. Dy. Director (Consumer Assistance): Graduate Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Demonstrated ability in dealing with consumer problems. 5 years' experience in power sector in areas directly connected to end users. Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis OR with regular service in Level-10, Level-8 or Level-6. Personnel Officer: Graduate degree from a recognized university. Officers holding analogous post on regular basis in Central/State Govt. OR any PSU under Central/State Govt. OR with 6 yrs. regular Service in the pay matrix Level - 6. Assistant Accounts Officer: Commerce Graduate from a recognized university. 06 years regular service in Junior Accounts cadre of a Central / State Govt. OR any PSU/ Corporation under Central / State Govt. with at least 4 years' experience in accounts branch.

selection_process: Shortlisting based on eligibility criteria Skill test / Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DERC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DERC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission (DERC) for filling up various administrative and professional vacancies on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced across various posts including Secretary, Joint Secretary, Dy. Director (Consumer Assistance), Personnel Officer, and Assistant Accounts Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 26 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DERC various posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode by visiting the official DERC website as specified in the recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts advertised under this recruitment notification is set at 56 years as per the deputation norms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Secretary post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Secretary post must possess a graduate degree from a recognized university along with required regular service experience in specified pay levels.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required for DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission for these positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered for the Assistant Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: The Assistant Accounts Officer post comes under Level-8 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, with a salary range of Rs. 47,600 to Rs. 1,51,100 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these deputation posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility criteria followed by a skill test or an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF, application portal link, and the official DERC website directly from the important links section provided in this article.
